title: UK-Iranian Man Arrested in Connection to RAF Fairford Air Base Incident
summary_full: British police said a 25-year-old British-Iranian dual national was arrested Thursday. British officials have said they believe Iran played a part in planning the incident at R.A.F. Fairford.
